name: Florida Digital Bill of Rights
description: Florida's consumer privacy law, narrower in scope than most other state comprehensive laws — applies only to entities with over $1 billion in global gross revenue meeting additional criteria (e.g. operating a digital app store, or deriving revenue from smart-speaker/voice-recognition or advertising with search-engine features).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Florida (florida.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Florida (florida.gov).
